title: Draggable floating pipeline log overlay
summary: Made the in-app floating Pipeline Log overlay draggable on desktop by using its header as the drag handle, clamping movement to the viewport, and preserving the fixed bottom-sheet layout on narrow screens.
reason: The overlay now opens globally, but operators need to reposition it when it covers active work in another tab.
behavior_before: The floating Pipeline Log overlay always opened at the fixed bottom-right desktop position and could only be resized, not moved.
behavior_after: The floating Pipeline Log overlay can be dragged by its header on desktop, remains inside the viewport, and resets to the responsive bottom-sheet layout on narrow screens.
tests_added: Extended tests.webview.test_webview_pipeline_log_window_static to assert drag wiring and simulate pointer drag movement in the focused Node smoke.
